headerDisplay: Connects Voltie EV chargers on your local network via the charger's HTTP API (default port 5059). Enable the HTTP API on the charger first.

discovery.title: Automatic discovery (mDNS/Bonjour)
discovery.description: Find Voltie chargers on the local network automatically. Chargers listed below are used as-is; discovery adds any others it finds.

username.title: Username (all chargers)
username.description: Used for every charger, including discovered ones, unless a charger entry has its own credentials. Only needed when the HTTP API has authentication enabled.

currentControl.title: Charging current dimmer (Lightbulb) (all chargers)
currentControl.description: Exposes the charging current limit as a dimmer: 0% = 6 A, 100% = hardware maximum. Siri can set it as a percentage.

chargeCompleteSensor.title: Charge complete sensor (Contact Sensor) (all chargers)
chargeCompleteSensor.description: Opens when the car finishes charging on its own (typically full) while still plugged in. A deliberate stop does not trigger it. Ideal for a "car is charged" notification.

accessLock.title: RFID access lock (Lock) (all chargers)
accessLock.description: Locked = charging requires an RFID card, Unlocked = free charging.

singlePhaseSwitch.title: Single-phase charging switch (all chargers)

oneOf.title: Auto (only when the charger supports it)

singlePhaseSwitch.description: Forces 1-phase charging (useful for solar surplus). Auto shows the switch only on chargers that report phase-switching support.

rebootSwitch.title: Reboot switch (all chargers)
rebootSwitch.description: Momentary switch that reboots the charger. Keep disabled unless you need it.

rearLedLight.title: Rear LED light (color Lightbulb) (all chargers)
rearLedLight.description: Exposes the charger's rear LED strip as a color lamp. On/off is the charger's persistent LED setting; a colour set from HomeKit is a temporary one-hour effect, after which the LED returns to the charger's own behaviour.

outOfServiceSwitch.title: Out of service switch (all chargers)
outOfServiceSwitch.description: On = the charger is out of service and cannot be used, for example during maintenance.

quietModeSwitch.title: Quiet mode switch (all chargers)
quietModeSwitch.description: On = display, front LED and buzzer off, for example at night. Off restores what was on before. The rear LED has its own lamp.

dlmDynamicSwitch.title: Dynamic load management switch (all chargers)
dlmDynamicSwitch.description: On = Dynamic mode: the charger adapts its current to the house consumption so the main fuse never trips. Needs an external meter (SensorBox or VoltieMeter). Off returns to the mode used before, or turns load management off.

ecoModeSwitch.title: Eco mode switch (all chargers)
ecoModeSwitch.description: On = Eco mode: charges from solar surplus, topped up from the grid to the 6 A minimum. Needs an external meter. Off returns to the mode used before.

greenModeSwitch.title: Green mode switch (all chargers)
greenModeSwitch.description: On = Green mode: charges from solar surplus only. Single-charger installations only; needs an external meter. Off returns to the mode used before.

gridControlSwitch.title: Grid Control switch (all chargers)
gridControlSwitch.description: On = Grid Control: starts charging when the grid voltage rises, so the solar inverter does not shut down. Works without a meter. Off returns to the mode used before.

keepLastSessionEnergy.title: Keep last session energy (all chargers)
keepLastSessionEnergy.description: Between sessions the Eve energy field shows the energy of the last session instead of 0.

eveHistory.title: Eve power history (all chargers)
eveHistory.description: Records the charging power every 10 minutes for the graphs in the Eve app (the Home app does not show it). Kept for up to 28 days in the Homebridge storage folder.

idTag.title: RFID id_tag for remote start (all chargers)
idTag.description: Only needed when a charger is in RFID mode: HomeKit starts then carry this RFID id. At least 8 characters: letters, digits, _ or -.

username.title: Username
username.description: Only needed if the charger's HTTP API has authentication enabled.

idTag.title: RFID id_tag for remote start
idTag.description: Optional. Sent with the start command when the charger requires RFID authorization. At least 8 characters: letters, digits, _ or -.
